planets.name: K2-381 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-381 with a 7.94-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: K2-381 b was found in 2022 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-381. Its orbit and size follow Christiansen et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
